pr_title: Refactor Sonos alarms and favorites updating
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Refactors the alarm and favorites handling in Sonos to utilize various update identifiers to avoid race conditions.

Each Sonos device keeps track of alarms and favorites locally and may not always be perfectly in sync when we query them as updates propagate between the devices. This ensures we're only processing the latest known update and will ignore stale data.

This also bumps `soco` as it's a dependency for this change (https://github.com/SoCo/SoCo/pull/851). Other `soco` changes should be non-breaking: https://github.com/SoCo/SoCo/milestone/21?closed=1. This also fixes #52950 via dependency upgrade.

When playing through the Sonos S2 App, an error occurs in the HA log.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.7.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

not sure, did not see it there during the beta testing

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sonos

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
N/A
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2021-07-13 11:02:54 WARNING (SyncWorker_57) [pysonos.data_structures_entry] DATA STRUCTURE UPGRADE FAIL. Unable to upgrade music library data structure to music service data structure because an entry is missing for DidlPodcast in DIDL_NAME_TO_QUALIFIED_MS_NAME. This should be reported as a bug.
```


### Additional information
